name: bestlife-holder-ingest-pull
description: Reads your mailboxes over IMAP every 15 minutes, without changing them, and files each new message in your store.

MAILBOXES.description: Your mailboxes, as JSON: [{"address":"you@example.com","host":"imap.example.com","port":993,"user":"you@example.com","key":"IMAP_PASSWORD"}]. Each key names a KEY_<key> secret on your access worker.

PER_RUN.description: At most this many new messages per mailbox per run.

BESTLIFE_HOLDER.description: Your Best Life holder id, as Settings › Stores shows it. May be left empty.

BESTLIFE_ARRIVED_URL.description: Where to tell Best Life a message arrived, once Settings › Stores gives you one (with a BESTLIFE_TOKEN secret you add then). Empty: nothing is told; mail is still filed in your store.

ACCESS.description: Your access worker, which opens each mailbox's password (deploy bestlife-holder-access first).

STATE.description: The last message read in each mailbox (a KV namespace in your account).
